description: This file contains a set of validation functions for various input fields such as length, email, IP, filename, URL, and SEO URL. It defines the logic for validating and sanitizing user input in the OpenCart system.

methods.name: oc_validate_length
methods.description: Validates if the string length is within the specified minimum and maximum bounds.

methods.name: oc_validate_email
methods.description: Validates if the provided email has a proper format and handles internationalized domain names.

methods.name: oc_validate_ip
methods.description: Checks if the provided string is a valid IP address.

methods.name: oc_validate_filename
methods.description: Validates the filename to contain only allowed characters, excluding special characters.

methods.name: oc_validate_url
methods.description: Checks if the provided string is a valid URL.

methods.name: oc_validate_seo_url
methods.description: Validates that the SEO URL contains only allowed characters, including Latin, Cyrillic, Greek letters, and digits with specific symbols.
